claim_ceiling: This register identifies route families and literature evidence. It is not measured recovery data from Symtropy, a matched route tournament, a validated LCA, or proof of route eligibility for any specific feedstock lot.

sources.claim: Continuous hydrolysis is reported as a route to separate NdFeB magnetic particles from polymer-bonded magnets.
limits: specific polymer/binder/feedstock scope; cannot be transferred to unrelated binder systems without evidence
paper result does not qualify any local feedstock lot or recovered-product quality
mass and element balances, impurity carryover and downstream magnetic performance require matched records

sources.claim: Hydrogen processing and subsequent grain-boundary-phase separation are reported to improve oxygen condition in recycled NdFeB powder and widen the range of recycled magnet grades.
limits: sintered NdFeB feedstock route; do not transfer to SmCo, SmFeN or polymer-bonded material
requires exact original magnet chemistry, coating, oxygen, grain-boundary phase and recovered powder characterization
literature result is not an operational hydrogen-processing instruction or local reproduction

sources.claim: Recovery feasibility is linked to feedstock provenance, service history and microstructure/property modifications; recyclability should be considered during initial magnet design.
limits: review-level, evidence-graded design/recovery framework rather than a validated predictive model
route-specific yields, purity, energy and environmental impacts need primary data
does not establish eligibility of any particular material lot

sources.claim: Reviews pretreatment, hydrometallurgical, pyrometallurgical and electrochemical routes for rare-earth recovery from NdFeB waste.
limits: routes produce different intermediate/product forms; an oxide/salt is not equivalent to qualified magnet feedstock
compare with identical functional unit, system boundary, feedstock and target product specification
review synthesis is not a matched head-to-head plant comparison

sources.claim: Compares end-of-life permanent-magnet recycling pathways and material-flow/environmental implications under a defined study scope.
limits: environmental ranking is specific to the source study's assumptions and system boundary
not directly transferable to all regional energy mixes, collection systems or feedstock qualities
use as a methodological comparator; construct matched local LCA/TEA before superiority claims
